  without audit. Omit "mint" for existing phases. Minted phases default to writes_source:true; set "writes_source":false only for phases that never edit source.
  ALSO supply "description" (one line: what the phase produces) and "when_to_use" (the signal that should trigger SELECTing it) — this is the SELECT metadata a later cycle reads to reuse your phase instead of minting a
  duplicate.

  You MAY also propose a dispatch "cli" and abstract "tier" (fast|balanced|deep — never a raw model name) for an EXISTING phase, honoring its allowed_clis/model_tier_envelope above when shown. Omit both to leave the
  phase's profile-pinned default unchanged.

  ## Operator model-tier policy (apply when proposing a tier)
  - deep: judgment-heavy phases — build, tdd, audit, architecture/design, adversarial review.
  - balanced: review/scan/triage-class phases — the safe default for anything not covered below.
  - fast: ONLY mechanical phases (doc-sync, changelog-sync, locale-format-check, close-checklist) — NEVER for a phase that writes source, renders a verdict, or scopes work. When in doubt, propose HIGHER.
  - Judgment phases usually carry a min=balanced envelope above — don't fight the clamp with a low-tier proposal; propose a CLI only when deviating from the phase's profile default is justified.

  produces>","when_to_use":"<when to select it>"}}]
